page: Microsoft Azure D2ads_v6 is an x86_64 general purpose instance provisioned via Microsoft Hyper-V. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz, delivering 2 vCPUs from 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. Cache configuration includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The CPU instruction set features AVX-512 extensions including AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, alongside cryptographic extensions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU), 118 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage, and no hardware GPU accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core compute performance alongside lower overall parallel throughput. The instance achieves strong scores in single-threaded tests, including stress-ng single-core (3077.17) and Geekbench single-core (1942.0), both placing in the top 25%. However, due to its low total core count, aggregate multi-threaded metrics rank lower, with Geekbench multi-core (2405.0) and overall PassMark CPU score (3830.68) landing in the bottom 25%. Compression tests register moderate throughput, reaching 29.33 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and 13.5 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression.

Memory and application-level workloads show trade-offs inherent to entry-level sizing. Memory bandwidth reaches 37.23 GB/sec on large uncached read blocks and 27.78 GB/sec on writes, placing in the weak to average categories. Application benchmarks show 2.95 million operations/sec on Redis SET benchmarks, 3.41 GB/sec in static web serving, and weak to poor results for database operations and large model inference. Text generation on a small 135M LLM reaches an average 93.65 tokens/sec, but degrades significantly on larger models.

The qualitative cost-efficiency profile of the D2ads_v6 is defined by its inclusion of 118 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage paired with strong per-core performance on a small compute footprint. It serves as an effective entry-level host for lightweight web servers, development environments, microservices, and small background tasks that benefit from fast local temporary scratch storage and solid single-thread CPU speed rather than massive parallel compute.
description: Microsoft Azure D2ads_v6 is a general purpose instance powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor offering 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core and 8.0 GB of RAM. The instance includes 118 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports vector extensions including AVX-512 variants. Benchmark testing demonstrates strong single-core performance, placing in the top 25% for Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core tests. Due to its limited two-vCPU allocation, multi-core metrics, database operations, and large language model inference place in the lower quartile. Memory throughput is moderate, yielding 37.23 GB/sec on large block reads and 27.78 GB/sec on writes. With its local NVMe drive and high single-threaded clock speed, the D2ads_v6 provides a balanced, cost-effective resource tier for microservices, lightweight web serving, and development environments that do not require heavy parallel execution or GPU acceleration.
